column1: # APSE prophage integration sites in Hamiltonella defensa S07 (strain H101).
# Coordinates are 1-based inclusive and refer to the delivered 2024 chromosome
# contig_02 (2,066,358 bp), so they can be applied to the published assembly.
# att_core is the direct repeat duplicated by integration; it is present once in
# the uninfected chromosome (attB) and once in the free phage (attP), and twice
# (attL, attR) once the prophage is in place.
# lysogenic  = reads crossing an att boundary from chromosome into phage
# excised    = reads running continuously across the empty attB
